caption: A long garden hose is coiled into loops on the lawn.

sa.check: A garden hose lies on a lawn.
The loops lie on the lawn.
The coiling proceeds loop by loop.

pc.expect: Each loop lies on top of the last, and the hose does not pass through itself.
pc.fail: It passes through itself; or passes through the lawn; or loops run into one another.

pc.expect: The length of hose still on the ground shrinks as the coil grows, and the hose bends smoothly without kinking.
pc.fail: The loose hose does not shrink; or the hose stretches; or it kinks like wire.

pc.expect: One continuous hose with two ends.
pc.fail: The hose splits; or the ends multiply; or a loop vanishes.

pc.expect: It coils only as the hands move it.
pc.fail: It coils itself; or uncoils; or slides.

pc.expect: The hose stays one hose and the hands keep their shape.
pc.fail: The hose merges with itself; or the hands pass through it; or it turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The hose's colour and the lawn stay the same.
pc.fail: The hose changes colour; or the lawn changes; or the garden rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
